changeSet.author: hunttech
changeSet.sql:
UPDATE hunttech_ai_function_configuration SET admin_configuration_id = (SELECT id FROM hunttech_admin_ai_configuration WHERE is_active = true ORDER BY priority_ DESC LIMIT 1), admin_model_name = COALESCE((SELECT default_model_name FROM hunttech_admin_ai_configuration WHERE is_active = true ORDER BY priority_ DESC LIMIT 1), 'deepseek-v4-flash'), fallback_policy = 'FALLBACK_TO_ADMIN', execution_policy = 'USER_OVERRIDE_ALLOWED' WHERE code = 'LLM_CHAT';
UPDATE hunttech_user_ai_profile SET admin_fallback_consent = true, admin_fallback_consent_version = '2026-09-05-v1', admin_fallback_consent_at = current_timestamp WHERE user_id IN (SELECT id FROM sec_user WHERE login = 'alan');

rollback.sql:
UPDATE hunttech_ai_function_configuration SET fallback_policy = 'ADMIN_DISABLED', execution_policy = 'PERSONAL_ONLY' WHERE code = 'LLM_CHAT';
UPDATE hunttech_user_ai_profile SET admin_fallback_consent = false, admin_fallback_consent_version = null, admin_fallback_consent_at = null WHERE user_id IN (SELECT id FROM sec_user WHERE login = 'alan');
